description: This file defines the core logic for a calculator engine, including enums for calculator keys and operators, and a class (`CalculatorEngine`) managing calculator state, input processing, and computation logic.

classes.name: CalculatorEngine
classes.description: A class managing calculator operations, current input, selected operator, and computation logic, providing methods to process key inputs and maintain calculator state.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Processes a calculator key press to update the calculator state accordingly.

methods.name: _clearAll
methods.description: Resets the calculator to its initial state.

methods.name: _backspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from current input, handling edge cases.

methods.name: _appendDecimal
methods.description: Appends a decimal point to the current input if not already present.

methods.name: _appendDigit
methods.description: Appends a digit to the current input.

methods.name: _setOperator
methods.description: Sets the current operator and computes any pending operation.

methods.name: _equals
methods.description: Performs the calculation based on current input, operator, and accumulator.

methods.name: _parseCurrent
methods.description: Parses the current input string to a double value.

methods.name: _compute
methods.description: Performs arithmetic operations based on the operator.

methods.name: _formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a double value to string for display, handling precision and trailing zeros.

methods.name: _digitForKey
methods.description: Converts a calculator key enum to its corresponding digit integer.
